note: Supersaturation and a seed (GAME_SPEC §9, §13.7, Stage 66; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 35): two beakers of the same clear copper sulfate solution, 0.0656 mol in 50 g of water (1.31 mol/kg, 1.06 times the model's solubility at the room's 20 C, 1.2375 mol/kg: saturated near 23 C and cooled undisturbed), and two jars each of one blue crystal of the pentahydrate, 10 mg. Left alone the solutions stay clear for days (Sheng's primary nucleation). A seed in the still beaker only grows; in the stirred one the stirrer chips fragments off it, each a crystal of its own, and the excess, about 1 g, comes out in minutes (chem_tool study seed; docs/DATA_SOURCES.md, Seeds).
